bends.note: Gourd is the strip between the lot fronts and the west bank of the canal; it follows the bank and narrows going south (about 32 ft at Hopple, 22 ft at Rachel, 15 ft here)
canal bank kinks here; Gourd (about 9-14 ft between the Xylotite works and the bank) turns more to the SSW and runs off the bottom of the sheet near x 5515

notes: Sheet drawn north up (slightly rotated). Names printed 'HOPPLE', 'HENSHAW AV.', 'SIDNEY AV.', 'MASSACHUSETTS AV.', 'CORMANY AV.', 'GOURD', 'RACHEL', 'TOWNSHIP'; suffix-less names recorded as Street. Henshaw Av. runs down the left edge in the binding: only its east building line (x ~228) is on this sheet, so its centreline (about 150 px further west) and its crossings with Hopple, Rachel and Township fall in the gutter / on the facing page and are not recorded (Henshaw/Hopple and Henshaw/Rachel are on sheet 281). Rachel is printed 50' west of Massachusetts and east of Cormany, 53' between Massachusetts and Cormany. Township stops at Cormany (Xylotite Mfg. Co. buildings occupy its line to the east), so Cormany/Township is a T. Gourd has no printed width; its centre is taken midway between the lot fronts and the canal's west bank line. Hopple crosses the canal on a bridge east of Gourd (bridge sides at y ~1196 and ~1358); Gourd continues north of Hopple onto sheet 289, so Hopple/Gourd is a cross.
